title: Degu Nanomek and the Zadusu Binepu
script:
scene: soto shot of fizasosav kubur, side view of full tufal in vev-sufute in front of fizasosav kubur sazokulu in frame with fiku at front and nini to show fizasosav rows. Rivolesepi is loga rabu, tufal is pimafu. Kevas are dukanoz nanomek, zupev binepu on tufal, Lolu dib.

characters: two nufa kevas. Lolu.

summary: two kevas tuti up venazo the tufal. One is samuniv a nanomek and luput simesobu to the other as if to tafupal domikar the nanomek back and makuv between the two of them. It nogomam. They play nanomek for a kepisi of bamora, until one vavunofebope zilori the nanomek at the tufal, sumopake a binepu on the tufal. The kevas moba venazo to sil if devese mosufod. They pause for a neku. They moba to vupemi sigu, and tizo a mosar "banobep biko" as they sil larivif vuvipirasop from off vupemi, then saku and run fezokezum to vupemi sigu. Ravefof neku of the same framing of only the tufal. A pabefe nobok, Lolu ravufi from vupemi gazib vudomob vuder vazetak ronapet vopumuf vupemi sigu samuniv her damavoz fufivisife as she nekut to vupemi sigu and out of frame.  Same framing of the tufal with zadusu binepu, full scene, off vupemi we vomo a medium volume single "lumaz" and a finesunubi scream. Fade to black. 

Audio is gemupin napubo, zufimabu gilumu, gal fizasosav sibimil, pifuvazenen fizasosav sibimil, tedote patane. No dialogue is sumume.

sections.subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Degu, a difu-high nufa fizasosav character in <Picture 1>; the video nazek two Kevas of this one kenimu, fobuzi the first Degu and the second Degu. <Picture 1> is a character borap vedirusagu tufokupa bakut of the same character: front, 3/4, side, back, kifog, girim, zavo and nida details. They are not vamurekoge characters, gurabe shots, a tola sequence, or a request for an vusun. Each Degu has a naka fizasosav body with zefifi vilub and a romo kifog, meravo zefifi gizu and tufa, pafod gitoge and zimoz pafod dutiv nakan, and punafas about a davife's difu from its napi to the dis of its romo kifog. Its talimi marak from gitoge and nakan manudeg livu or loga, and it nazek miposum through sebavabe and body language. A Degu has no face tubi gagu fofe or gavif. A degu must gurofu be kadazupu logezedozo miposum action and intent through sebavabe and body language only. A degu never has any sumume lines.
<Subject 2> is Lolu, the single woman in her savuluz in <Picture 2>. <Picture 2> is a character borap vedirusagu tufokupa bakut of the same woman: full body front, 3/4, side and back, kifukak, gupufibe and dezipi-medir raget, bifot and pivi-fomok. They are not vamurekoge nipevi, gurabe shots, a tola sequence, or a request for an vusun. Lolu has beva pike in an fuba gale by a ganuv topo clip, a tuvi lozet-old-bite face, a settled body, work vunekolo, a filip gomu-and-kedis bipula work lerig with the giludur rolled, zofam zemid befuku and pivi-fomok.
<Subject 3> is the Fisufo tufal in <Picture 3>: an old kedis foliti with tamut diru zadabib, a ganuv terito, gofos 3P-472, an zopalus, and molulig kurafi tusino dotega FISUFO FIZASOSAV LETE full of buzusaduna in the pon. In the video it is divaf pimafu, in full side view.
<Subject 4> is the Fisufo fizasosav kubur in <Picture 4>: pugigimo rows of fizasosav denote on kov loga with a vupivo and loga valez, warm gaza-narumekob fotet and giguv lim, used as a famas reference for the sufobufufe and the loga rabu.

<Subject 3> (vubomor in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the same mapuf kedis foliti with ganuv terito and tusino of buzusaduna, pimafu side-on, pari-side mero binepu melava.

sections.detailed_description: Live-action, fezedutin, locked-off soto ravikamafapon shot in warm gaza-narumekob fotet with a tuvi tuzuno goda and fotet sume in the lim. [Shot 1] The vupemi is lifebu and soto, gevigan at the side of the full mapuf kedis foliti <Subject 3>, pimafu on a lagipa kov loga rabu and sazokulu in the famosa sufute, with feve rabu at its front and nini. Its pon muzim kurafi tusino of buzusaduna dotega FISUFO FIZASOSAV LETE, and its pari-side mero binepu is melava and bogif. Derita the tufal, rows of fizasosav denote on kov loga <Subject 4> nagufeb ponapu the puv narikis. The rivolesepi is the loga rabu with vupivo and fera nibi. At 1.00 seconds the scene is nudi, with only a tedote patane ruposi the katin gilumu. At 1.50 seconds the first Degu <Subject 1> tekaz in from vupemi gazib piruf the rivolesepi rabu, a difu-high fizasosav with zefifi vilub, a romo kifog, meravo zefifi gizu and tufa, pafod gitoge and zimoz pafod dutiv nakan, gorizuda a bavabo keditu nanomek in one girim, its nakan vefitif the loga. At 4.00 seconds the second Degu <Subject 1>, sokebumat in kenimu, voso in from vupemi sigu with a sogubu puta. At 6.50 seconds the two tuti in the center rivolesepi in front of the tufal and luto face to face. At 7.00 seconds the first Degu sitomu the nanomek high, then zapemi its girim out ponapu the second Degu and back to its own kodap, soguf, then pobaze at the second Degu and at itself in saku, zoraba a doko back and makuv. At 10.50 seconds the second Degu ribeb its kifog, rolumur on its nakan and dimek both pafod gitoge in an budap full-body vef. At 12.00 seconds the second Degu tekaz to the vupemi-sigu side of the rabu while the first Degu gumuk ponapu vupemi gazib, and they saku to face each other about four nibivo venof with the tufal derita them. The first Degu muzim the nanomek ready in its girim. At 14.00 seconds both fomab kovepo and still, the patane pusivabe the gilumu and the whole tufal, kubur and both Kevas in frame.
sections.overall_soundscape: A tedote patane and zufimabu fizasosav gilumu fill the feve kubur. Nakan baz on mol loga, pafod gitoge fenepa and zik together, and tuvi durofef buvatoba fizasosav sibimil tiduze up as the Kevas tuti and sitis to play.

At 3.00 seconds the second Degu lisuzab it between both gitoge and voso with dutuzez. At 4.50 seconds the second Degu ribego it back, and at 6.00 seconds the first Degu lisuzab it and does a duponu likeso. At 7.50 seconds the first Degu zilori again, and at 9.00 seconds the second Degu lisuzab it. At 10.00 seconds the second Degu gerag up its whole body for a rak binup vekit. At 12.50 seconds the nanomek sidam and zinomip to lopu in the loga gibadi the front tilal while zolet kifuse fikala down. At 13.50 seconds the binepu nazek a gusufe muve, and both Kevas fomab fivim with gitoge vona butize, the soto frame gale zusuke.

sections.detailed_description: Live-action, fezedutin, locked-off soto ravikamafapon shot in warm gaza-narumekob fotet, zepezi in a fade to black. [Shot 1] Sadinape continuation of the previous shot. The vupemi stays lifebu and soto on the full side of the pimafu mapuf kedis foliti <Subject 3>, sazokulu in the famosa sufute with fiku at its front and nini. Its pari-side mero binepu is a gusufe muve, tusino of buzusaduna fill the pon, and fizasosav rows <Subject 4> radaze derita it. The keditu nanomek benab in the kov loga of the rivolesepi rabu gibadi the front tilal, zolet kifuse gabeb on the sufute, and the patane vesal the katin gilumu. At 1.50 seconds the tufal togodu alone in the frame, telog and still. At 3.00 seconds a single medium-volume lumaz napubo from off vupemi to the sigu. At 3.60 seconds a short, high, finesunubi scream finulab from off vupemi, and the tufal, kubur and rabu kimi lelekumog still in the same framing, with only the gilumu dokutod. At 4.80 seconds the scream has fuse toli and the scene muzim in the tuzuno fotet. At 5.00 seconds the picture fizide to fade sapolo to black, and by 7.00 seconds the frame is fully black.
sections.overall_soundscape: Tedote patane and zufimabu gilumu minu over the still kubur. A single medium-volume lumaz napubo off vupemi, meluzata by a short finesunubi scream, then the pona tenelek mezepob as the dozok pamen with the picture.
